source: Key names from bscpylgtv's dump of a 2021 webOS 6 set (docs/available_settings_C1.md). Run `tv.py probe` to see which ones this TV reports.

homePromotion.why: Promoted content and ad banner on the home screen (Settings > General > Home Settings > Home Promotion).

homeAutoLaunch.why: Home screen with its ad rows opening by itself at power-on.

adCookie.why: Advertising identifier cookie used to track the TV across apps.

lmt.why: Limit Ad Tracking: asks apps and LG not to use the ad ID for targeting.

doNotSellMyPersonalInformation.why: US opt-out of LG selling or sharing viewing data.

screenSaverAd.why: Ads shown in the screen saver.

aiNudge.why: Pop-up suggestions ("nudges") over what you are watching.

welcomeFeature.why: Welcome/tips cards on the home screen. Harmless; turn off with --optional.

livePlus.why: Live Plus: automatic content recognition (ACR) that fingerprints what is on screen, including HDMI inputs.

promotionStreamer.why: Promotional streams/banners in the home and live TV.

enableToastPopup.why: Toast notifications for tips and offers. Also hides some useful ones; turn off with --optional.

quickStartMode.why: Quick Start+ keeps the TV half-awake on standby (network active). Off saves power but slows power-on by a few seconds.
